findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: injection_quick_check, presign_check, presign_check_explain, token_check, injection_check · Private data: presign_quick_check, token_quick_verdict, injection_quick_check, presign_check, token_verdict, token_check, wallet_approvals, screen_wallet, injection_check · Public sink: injection_quick_check, presign_check, presign_check_explain, token_verdict, token_check, screen_wallet, injection_check · Destructive: presign_check, feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: injection_quick_check, presign_check, presign_check_explain, token_check, injection_check · Private data: presign_quick_check, token_quick_verdict, injection_quick_check, presign_check, token_verdict, token_check, wallet_approvals, screen_wallet, injection_check · Public sink: injection_quick_check, presign_check, presign_check_explain, token_verdict, token_check, screen_wallet, injection_check · Destructive: presign_check, feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
